properties.name: type
properties.description:
Activation behavior, mirroring the native `<button type>`:
- `button` (default): no implicit form action.
- `submit`: submits the associated form (`requestSubmit`, so the form's
  `submit` event fires and constraint validation runs).
- `reset`: resets the associated form.

properties.name: shapeMorph
properties.description: Enable M3 Expressive shape morphing on press and toggle

properties.name: mirrorIcon
properties.description:
Mirror leading and trailing icons horizontally when the button is
rendered in a right-to-left context. Set this on buttons that use
**directional** Material Symbols (arrows, chevrons, send, reply…)
— non-directional icons (add, search, favorite…) should leave it
`false` so the glyph stays semantically correct.

properties.name: suppressExpandIconFlip
properties.description:
When true, suppresses the default 180° trailing-icon rotation while
`aria-expanded="true"`. Use when the consumer swaps the glyph (e.g.
docked `md-date-picker` month/year triggers use `chevron_right`).

properties.name: fullWidth
properties.description:
Stretch the button to fill its inline-axis container.

Switches the host from `inline-flex` to `flex` and sets
`inline-size: 100%` so the button consumes the full width of its
parent — the standard pattern for primary CTAs in forms, modals,
and bottom sheets. The size's `min-block-size` (touch target) is
preserved.

For arbitrary fixed widths or heights, set the
`--md-button-width`, `--md-button-height`, `--md-button-min-width`,
`--md-button-min-height`, or `--md-button-max-width` CSS custom
properties on the host instead.

properties.name: roleOverride
properties.description:
Override the default `role="button"`. Used by composite widgets such as
`md-date-picker` day cells (`role="gridcell"`). Leave empty for `button`.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Button
description: A discrete, committed action. Five emphasis levels, five sizes, round/square shape with M3-Expressive shape morphing, optional toggle mode, and native form participation (submit/reset) via ElementInternals.

notes: Dedicated native Button uses source size/density metrics, variant/toggle/disabled color tokens, Roboto and Material Symbols fonts, slot fallback, and source loader placement.

Actual SwiftUI isPressed drives shape morphing (200ms press, 400ms release). Pointer-origin ripple uses source farthest-corner geometry and 450ms growth/150ms fade; hover and pointer geometry are forwarded by the native preview. Reduce Motion suppresses shape/ripple animations. Per-instance CSS overrides are not reproduced.

Loading draws the source 48-vertex morphing polygons with the original 4.55s keyframes and easing; Reduce Motion uses the source opacity pulse. Native button groups do not automatically inject connected corner props. RTL icon mirroring uses native layout direction; expanded trailing-icon rotation requires an explicit aria-expanded property on the native node.
mdClick describes the proposed state before commit and includes value, toggle, selected, href and target; mdChange follows commit and includes selected and value. originalEvent is omitted.

AWCButtonAction dispatches actual native capture, target and bubble phases before defaults. preventDefault vetoes activation; stopPropagation retains same-scope listeners and stopImmediatePropagation stops them. Legacy onEvent receives final cancellation, propagationPath and native activation metadata. Native mdChange is noncancelable. Soft-disabled and loading controls keep native keyboard focus while suppressing activation.

type submit/reset uses the nearest AWCFormScope or an explicit owner registry. All 13 source form-control families auto-register with stable per-view identity, ordered successful values and validation. Cancelable mdSubmit/mdReset precede form effects; reset restores initial native bindings (OTP clears). Single-line Enter activates the first registered default submit button. AWCFormEncoding generates local UTF-8 URL-encoded data without network submission. target is passed to AWCURLRouter; raw nonempty href suppresses form actions.

AWCNavigationCoordinator implements local _self/_blank/_parent/_top and named presentation contexts, current-base relative resolution, ordered histories/back and host veto/presentation callbacks. AWCButtonNavigationDemo shows real button propagation controls and local navigation without external page loads. Named reuse is an explicit native policy, not source noopener browser behavior.

groupTabindex implements the source null/0/-1 native focus contract: -1 skips sequential keyboard entry while retaining pointer, programmatic and accessibility actions. Hard-disabled excludes focus; soft-disabled/loading remain focusable and inert. Positive HTML tabindex sorting is not reproduced.

roleOverride supports native button/link/gridcell mappings with safe inference for empty/unknown roles. Gridcell selected state is independent of toggle. AppKit exposes a native actionable cell; UIKit supplies button/selected traits and data-table-cell coordinates through explicit AWCGridCellContext, not arbitrary ARIA roles or a browser calendar grid.

Native responder/accessibility assertions run on macOS. UIKit focus-engine/responder synchronization is implemented against documented iOS 17+ APIs, but this host has no iOS SDK/device to validate hardware keyboard or VoiceOver runtime behavior.

HTML_FORM.description: Actual native md-button submit/reset and text-field Enter use explicit form owners, all 13 source form-control families, source successful-value rules, ordered entries, validation, cancelable form events and reset bindings. Encoding is local and deterministic.
limitations: This implements the native form contract, not DOM ElementInternals, HTML form attributes, browser validation bubbles, autofill, CSS pseudo-classes or HTTP navigation. Explicit owner IDs resolve through an injected AWCFormRegistry.

ICU patterns and Foundation URL parsing differ from browser JavaScript v-mode regex and URL parsing. UTF-16 length, common email/URL/number constraints, time bounds and native custom validators are supported; HTML dirty-value validity timing and every ValidityState flag are not reproduced.

Implicit submission uses native single-line onSubmit and the first registered default submit button. Source number-field commits then submits directly. Browser composition/deferred autocomplete selection and DOM tree-order algorithms are not emulated.

Source md-button requestSubmit does not contribute a submitter name/value. Native submit(submitter:) can carry explicit host metadata, without adding a source button entry. Native form events are mdSubmit/mdReset/mdInvalid, not browser SubmitEvent/ResetEvent objects.

CANCELABLE_EVENT.description: Actual md-button activation dispatches scoped native capture, target and bubble listeners with a stable path/target/current scope, explicit boundaries, synchronous cancellation and both propagation stops. Defaults follow accepted mdClick; noncancelable mdChange follows toggle commit. Legacy observations include final cancellation, native activation metadata and path.
limitations: These are explicit native scopes and boundaries, not DOM nodes, browser capture/retargeting, shadow roots or a browser composedPath. Boundary crossing is a native dispatch option; target identity is never silently retargeted.

Activation metadata identifies entry through native control, implicit-submit or programmatic action. It does not fabricate a DOM MouseEvent, raw OS event, modifier/middle-button semantics or browser isTrusted. Finished synchronous contexts cannot be canceled later.

DOM_GLOBAL.description: Observable native contexts resolve safe relative routes against current source history, implement self/blank/parent/top destinations and reusable named contexts, and provide local back navigation. Host approval precedes state changes; presentation callbacks observe committed state. The navigation demo renders local context and history state without external navigation.
limitations: Native contexts replace presentation destinations, not browser window/document objects, browsing-context groups, window.open, opener relationships, referrers, origin security or HTTP page loads. No network request or application launch occurs in the coordinator.

Named destinations are intentionally reusable native contexts. The source browser route uses noopener/noreferrer and may create fresh browsing contexts for named targets. Reserved native targets are case-insensitive; other underscore-prefixed names are rejected.

Relative routes use Foundation URL resolution and explicit native context base URLs; URL parsing is not claimed identical to the browser. Schemes are allowlisted and executable/file/data routes rejected. The default SwiftUI openURL fallback still delegates external presentation to the host and does not interpret browser target contexts.

SHADOW_DOM.description: An explicit native component tree owns nested content and rendering without accessing browser shadow roots.
limitations: This replaces component content ownership; it does not implement CSS shadow-tree encapsulation or DOM retargeting.

DOM_QUERY.description: Typed tree traversal finds native descendants by stable node ID or source tag without querying browser elements.
limitations: Supports explicit native ID/tag lookup, not arbitrary CSS selectors, live DOM collections or imperative HTMLElement references.

SLOT_INTROSPECTION.description: Native named-child lookup and dynamic fallback are used by md-button for default content, leading/trailing icons and loader.
limitations: Operates on declarative native child values; browser assignedElements, slotchange events and flattened DOM slot semantics do not exist.

notes: Native Compose button with explicit forms, cancelable action scopes, safe routing and named content; browser-specific gaps are described in nativeEquivalents.

Dedicated Compose button matches source size/density rules, all five palette/toggle variants, bundled source Roboto and Material Symbols fonts, 200ms press/400ms release corner morph, source pointer-origin ripple timing and polygon loading animation. Real Compose PressInteraction owns press state. Source slots replace icon/label/loader fallbacks. Native form scopes automatically register source field adapters, collect ordered successful entries, apply declarative rules and support vetoable submit/reset and Enter; native action scopes can synchronously cancel defaults or stop scoped propagation; safe application routing carries target metadata. Literal browser form APIs, browser documents/origins, DOM nodes, platform elevation shadows, antialiasing and unrestricted browser ARIA roles remain different. Native groupTabindex supports null/0 sequential entry and -1 omission while preserving native programmatic focus, touch and accessibility actions. Hard-disabled controls are excluded; soft-disabled/loading controls remain focusable and block activation. roleOverride supports button and gridcell; unknown values safely retain Button semantics. Grid cells expose selected state independent of toggle plus explicit AWCGridScope/AWCGridCellScope collection metadata. mdClick reports proposed selected state before commit; mdChange follows commit. DOM originalEvent is omitted. RTL mirroring/expanded rotation currently applies to icon string fallbacks; custom icon slots retain their own transforms. Per-instance CSS custom properties are not evaluated.

HTML_FORM.description: AWC source field adapters register automatically with native form scopes. Shared declarative rules, ordered successful-control entries, duplicate names, multi-values, native Enter/default submission, vetoable submit/reset, initial-state restoration and explicit owner IDs replace the button form contract.
limitations: Native scope ownership replaces ElementInternals; no DOM nodes, browser validation popup or browser network submission is created.
Pattern validation uses Kotlin/Java full-match regular expressions, not the HTML JavaScript v-flag grammar. Native declarative text types cover text, email, URL and number.
Entry order follows native registration order. Applications that reorder retained keyed controls must re-register them when a new data order is required.

SHADOW_DOM.description: Scoped Compose content supplies the button label, leading/trailing icons and loader without a shadow root.
limitations: This is native composition; browser style encapsulation and DOM node access are not exposed.

DOM_QUERY.description: Explicit named-content lookup and injected navigation replace the button-specific anchor and slot queries.
limitations: Arbitrary CSS selectors and DOM traversal are not provided.

SLOT_INTROSPECTION.description: Observable composition replaces slot assignment inspection; adding/removing registered content updates the button and restores absent-slot fallbacks. Legacy content lambdas remain supported.
limitations: Slots contain composables rather than HTMLElement collections. Custom icon content retains its own transforms.

DOM_GLOBAL.description: Safe relative links resolve against the source native context current URL. Observable native contexts implement self, blank, parent, top and reusable named destinations, independent history, back and subtree close. A host can reject navigation before commit and present accepted destinations after commit. Unsafe raw links never fall through to form actions.
limitations: Contexts are native application state, not browser windows, documents, origins or opener relationships; no page is fetched by the coordinator.

Named native destinations are deliberately reusable; source window.open with noopener/noreferrer may instead create fresh browser contexts. Browser modifier/middle-click navigation and window APIs are not reproduced.
URLs must parse as native URIs. Applications supply presentation for coordinator destinations; the legacy default router still opens absolute Android URIs.

CANCELABLE_EVENT.description: Synchronous native capture, target and bubble dispatch uses stable target/path/scope IDs and ordered listeners. Cancelable mdClick runs before defaults, with separate stopPropagation and stopImmediatePropagation controls; committed mdChange is noncancelable. Explicit boundaries and nonbubbling events are supported; legacy callbacks still observe actions after dispatch.
limitations: The event path contains explicit native scopes, not DOM nodes or browser shadow-tree retargeting.
Activation metadata defaults to unknown when the host cannot identify the source; DOM originalEvent, isTrusted, browser modifiers and cancellation of native OS input are not claimed.
